title: Executive Overview
subtitle: Store performance for the selected period

definition.netSales: Total sales after discounts and returns, per the approved reporting rules.
definition.grossProfit: Net sales minus cost of goods sold.
definition.grossMargin: Gross profit as a share of net sales.
definition.orders: Orders recognised as sales in the period.
definition.averageOrderValue: Net sales divided by order count.
definition.discountRate: Discounts as a share of gross sales.
definition.returns: Refunded value for returns processed in the period.
definition.returnRate: Returns as a share of gross sales.
definition.newCustomers: Customers registered for the first time in the period.
definition.inventoryValue: Current on-hand stock valued at cost.

formula.grossProfit: Net sales − cost of goods sold

coverage.label: Cost coverage
coverage.explain: Share of sold units with a recorded cost. The lower it is, the less reliable profit becomes.
coverage.unavailableReason: Cost coverage is below 50%, so no trustworthy profit figure can be shown.

trend.title: Sales and profit over the period
trend.empty: No sales in the selected period.

categories.title: Top categories by net sales
categories.empty: No category data for the selected period.

highlights.title: Management highlights
highlights.empty: No material changes in this period.
highlights.salesUp: Sales rose {{percent}} versus the previous period.
highlights.salesDown: Sales fell {{percent}} versus the previous period.
highlights.marginDownSalesUp: Gross margin fell {{points}} points despite sales growth.
highlights.cogsCoverageLow: Cost coverage is only {{percent}}, so profit figures need review.
highlights.salesGrowing: Sales rose {{percent}} versus the previous period.
highlights.salesDeclining: Sales fell {{percent}} versus the previous period.
highlights.profitConcentration: {{percent}} of gross profit comes from just 3 products.
highlights.discountDependency: {{percent}} of sales value depends on discounts.
highlights.sizeConcentration: {{percent}} of demand is concentrated in just 3 sizes.

warnings.title: Data notes
warnings.COGS_COVERAGE_LOW: Some sold units have no recorded cost, so profit may be overstated.
warnings.COGS_COVERAGE_CRITICAL: Cost data is insufficient to show a trustworthy profit.
warnings.INVENTORY_COST_COVERAGE_LOW: Some stock items have no recorded cost, so inventory value is understated.
warnings.COMPARISON_BASE_ZERO: The comparison period has no data, so percentage change cannot be calculated.
warnings.EXCHANGE_COGS_UNREVERSED: Exchange orders do not reverse the original order's cost, so cost may be double-counted.
warnings.EXCHANGE_CREDIT_RETAINED: Net sales include {{creditRetained}} of exchange credit the customer has not used.
warnings.ORPHAN_RETURN_ITEMS: Some return lines are not linked to a sold line and cannot be attributed to products.
warnings.STOCK_SOURCE_DIVERGENCE: The legacy product stock figure disagrees with live variant stock.
warnings.UNCATEGORISED_SALES_HIGH: A large share of sales has no category assigned.
warnings.RETURNS_FALLBACK_USED: Return tables could not be read, so returns were not deducted.
warnings.NAN_VALUES_IGNORED: Corrupt numeric values were ignored in the calculation.
warnings.FILTERED_EXCLUDES_RETURNS: With a product filter applied, figures come straight from order lines and returns are not deducted, because a return is not tied to a specific product.
warnings.BREAKDOWN_EXCLUDES_RETURNS: Breakdown values are before returns that cannot be attributed to a product.
warnings.PRODUCT_LIST_TRUNCATED: There are more products than the display limit, so only the highest-selling ones are shown.
warnings.SIZE_SCOPE_REQUIRED: Choose a single product type to see size analysis, because size ranges differ between types.
warnings.SIZE_SCOPE_APPLIED: Colour-only and one-size products are excluded from size analysis.
warnings.SIZES_SOLD_OUT: Some sizes sold during the period and now have no stock.

states.emptyBody: No sales were recorded in the selected period. Try widening the range.
states.errorTitle: Could not load the executive overview
states.errorBody: Something failed while computing the data. No numbers are shown, to avoid presenting incorrect information.
states.restricted: You do not have permission to view this metric
